description: Hosted MCP integration for using permitted saved public Instagram research in AI assistants. Read source-linked reports, compare two saved account reports, check access, and prepare fresh research for owner review. Streamable HTTP at https://www.instaseer.com/mcp with OAuth 2.1. Reading saved evidence does not start collection; fresh research requires owner confirmation in Instaseer. Available tools depend on enabled capabilities and granted permissions. Public repository contains documentation and examples.

notes: No new endpoint health test or authenticated client certification is claimed. The repository MIT license covers documentation and configuration examples, not the hosted backend.
